# Official Website — Required Content Checklist

- [ ] Legal issuer identity (name, jurisdiction) — from `LEGAL_ISSUER_TEMPLATE.md`
- [ ] Token facts (issuer address, currency code, supply) — link to or mirror `docs/XRPL_VERIFICATION_SNAPSHOT.md`
- [ ] Honest market data — do not cherry-pick; if market cap is low, either omit market-cap claims entirely or state the real figure
- [ ] Official links list (this repo, official social accounts, official contract/issuer address) with a statement to verify against impersonators
- [ ] Risk warning (no guarantee of value, no reserve backing unless proven otherwise, XRPL asset risk)
- [ ] Contact method on the official domain
- [ ] Version/date control on every published document (footer with last-updated date)
- [ ] Explicit statement of what is live vs. planned (link to `ROADMAP_TEMPLATE.md` once filled)

## Language to avoid until substantiated

- "Government-grade," "military-grade," "audited," "insured," "backed by reserves," or similar unless there is an independent, citable source for the claim. `docs/EVIDENCE_MAP.md` currently finds no such substantiation for the sovereign/custody architecture referenced in related repositories.
